name: prose-research
description: Provenance for prose: take sources in (a URL, a file, a PDF's text), keep a dossier of quotable passages with locations and a claims ledger (claim, source, quote, the writer's confidence) in the shared writing-identity registry with undo, and check a draft deterministically — every ledger quote verbatim against its source, every link, every sentence that makes a claim no entry backs. Hands quote provenance to the fidelity critic. Never says a claim is true, never ranks sources, never saves without approval.
